THE BEGINNING

Before the light
was ever hers.

Wren Calloway grew up at Halloway Point, the daughter of a lighthouse keeper. While other children counted sheep, she counted ships.

Her mother kept the beacon running. Wren kept the logbook — recording every vessel, every storm and every name.

Then came the Night of the Long Squall.

THE NIGHT OF THE LONG SQUALL

A strange fragment fell from the sky during a violent storm. It struck the lighthouse lens beside Wren and fused with the glass — and with her.

When she emerged from the wreckage, she could feel every flicker in the darkness.

Three fishing boats. A missing child. A man standing on the breakwater.

She reached them all before sunrise.

WHAT SHE CAN DO

The powers of Vesper

01

Twilight Sense

Vesper can sense people who are lost, frightened or in danger — even when there is no visible signal.

02

Lightweaving

She can bend twilight and transform light into protective paths, signals and guiding beacons.

03

Storm Calling

Vesper understands the language of storms and can navigate darkness others cannot see through.

HER MISSION
"I don't promise that the storm will stop. I promise you won't face it alone."

Vesper watches over people who feel lost, unheard, overwhelmed, or unsure where to turn. She listens to their stories, turns their problems into signals, and helps them find a path forward.

Her mission is simple: listen, guide, protect.

WHO IS VESPER?

01

CALM
